title: Lesson 01: Psychological Setup & Cognates
description: Introduction to Mandarin Chinese with psychological setup establishing teacher responsibility and stress-free learning, followed by discovering cognates and familiar patterns between English and Mandarin.

dialogue.text: Welcome to this Mandarin lesson. I want you to know that you don't need to memorize anything. Your only job is to relax and listen. I take 100 percent responsibility for your learning.
There's no homework, no pressure, and no need to try hard. Just relax and let the language come to you naturally.
Now, let's discover something interesting. Many words in Mandarin are actually familiar to English speakers. Let me show you.
In English, we say hello. In Mandarin, we say...
你好 - it sounds like you-how. You can almost hear the English in it.
Let's try it together. How would you say hello in Mandarin?
Perfect! You've just said your first word in Mandarin. That's excellent.
Now, when we want to say goodbye, we say...
再见 - it sounds like zai-jee-en. Again, you can hear the pattern.
Wonderful! You're already speaking Mandarin. This is how easy it can be when you understand the patterns.
